name: Hold the Gate
hint: "2/2" on a plate: two friends standing on it keep the gate open.
why4: The gate needs two on a plate: two hold it from outside while two go in and hold the inside plate; a lone player inside cannot hold a 2-plate.
solution: P1 and P2 stand on the outer plate at x=8-9 (counter shows 2/2); gate A at x=13 opens.
P3 and P4 walk through the gate and stand on the inner plate at x=16-17.
P1 and P2 walk through the gate and stop at x=14-15, just past it (or hop over P3 and P4); then P3 and P4 step off and the gate closes behind everyone.

P1 stands at the left end of the 3-high shelf (x=23-26; it has 2 tiles of headroom, so everyone else walks under it); P2 jumps on P1's head and up onto the shelf, touches the key at x=25 and jumps down on the far side.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=31-32; P2 opens the door at x=40; all press Down.
